ns2:course.label: Aerospace Systems Design II
ns2:course.description: Conceptual design project of either an aircraft or spacecraft flight system to satisfy a given set of requirements. Project team organization. Emphasis on sizing, trade studies and design optimization, subsystem integration, and technical communication skills. Students must enroll in a two term sequence, AE 440 and AE 441. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: AE 440.
